mapper.select: SELECT e.EVENT_ID, e.MATCH_ID, e.TEAM_ID, e.EVENT_TIME, e.EVENT_TYPE, e.PLAYER_ID, e.ASSIST_PLAYER_ID, TO_CHAR(m.MATCH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS MATCH_DATE, NVL(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, NVL(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME FROM MATCH_EVENTS e JOIN MATCHES m ON m.MATCH_ID = e.MATCH_ID JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE (e.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId} OR e.ASSIST_PLAYER_ID = #{playerId}) AND e.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2) AND m.MATCH_DATE >= #{startDate} AND m.MATCH_DATE < #{endDate} ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC, e.EVENT_TIME ASC, e.EVENT_ID ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MATCHES m USING (SELECT #{matchId} AS MATCH_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (m.MATCH_ID = s.MATCH_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET m.MATCH_DATE = #{matchDate}, m.HOME_SCORE = #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, m.AWAY_SCORE = #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, m.STATUS = #{status}, m.ENDED_AT = #{endedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{matchDate}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{status}, #{notice, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{endedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES ORDER BY MATCH_DATE ASC

SELECT MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES WHERE MATCH_DATE >= #{startDate} AND MATCH_DATE <= #{endDate} ORDER BY MATCH_DATE ASC
SELECT MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES WHERE MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCH_EVENTS ( MATCH_ID, TEAM_ID, EVENT_TIME, EVENT_TYPE, PLAYER_ID, ASSIST_PLAYER_ID ) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{teamId}, #{eventTime}, #{eventType}, #{playerId}, #{assistPlayerId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, MATCH_ID, TEAM_ID, EVENT_TIME, EVENT_TYPE, PLAYER_ID, ASSIST_PLAYER_ID FROM MATCH_EVENTS WHERE MATCH_ID = #{matchId} ORDER BY EVENT_TIME ASC, EVENT_ID ASC
